summary: Iteration 21 — Cache-busting fix verified on preview sandbox. Backend: new middleware `api_reads_are_never_cached` sets `Cache-Control: no-store` on all GET /api/* responses while preserving `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for /api/files/<existing> (verified against local backend). All 5 cache-header pytest tests pass. Frontend: order page live-updates from pending → accepted WITHOUT reload within ~5s after the DB flip; `order-eta-time` renders the ETA (12:47) and the tracker shows `Acceptée`. Polling cadence /api/orders/{id} ~4s confirmed. Regression: home menu loads (home-title + 20 product cards), /staff/login shows staff-backend-host text, no console errors from api layer. Order 6ab911a41640440ce55631b1 was snapshotted and restored to its original status=completed. One minor RN console warning observed (shadow* deprecated → use boxShadow), unrelated to this fix.

minor.issue: Preview edge proxy (Cloudflare) rewrites our `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` to `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` on egress. Backend itself serves the correct immutable header (verified via http://localhost:8001). Production domain not affected by this test. No code change required.

rca_of_issue: Bug (iteration 31) was: after the restaurant accepts an order, the customer order page did not update because web browsers (iOS Safari in particular) were serving the polled GET /api/orders/{id} responses from the HTTP cache. Fix: (1) FastAPI middleware forces `Cache-Control: no-store` on every GET /api/* read while leaving the explicit `immutable` header on /api/files/*; (2) frontend request() passes `cache: 'no-store'` on web for GET requests. Verified end-to-end on the preview sandbox: a DB-level flip from pending to accepted reflected in the UI within ~5s with no reload.
